# Project Workflow

## Authority

State that this document owns operational sequence and references governance for rules.

## Bootstrap

Define remote-state verification and change-local authority resolution.

## Readiness

Define the executable readiness questions and when scope/decision/ADR work is required. Reference governance instead of redefining Goal semantics.

## Branch and pull request flow

Define synchronization, topic branch, coherent-change, PR, review, and merge procedure.

## Validation

Define docs-only and build-affecting gates, patch checking, staged-diff checking, and permanent-branch validation behavior.

## Post-merge

Define change-local re-read, direct-dependent/Goal re-evaluation, and selection of the next ready action.

## Release

Define `development` to `production` release flow and hotfix reconciliation.
